knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETED: Unified framework for Leibniz-type formulas via Dirichlet eta/beta functions. β(1)=π/4 proved, η(2)=π²/12 relationship proved algebraically, Catalan constant defined, η(1)=ln(2) axiomatized.
builtItems: Unified etaTerm/betaTerm framework for generalized Leibniz sums

η(s) = (1-2^{1-s})·ζ(s) links alternating to standard zeta
η(2) = π²/12 follows from (1/2)·ζ(2), provable from hasSum_zeta_two
η(1) = ln(2) requires Abel theorem (not in Mathlib) — must axiomatize
Catalan G = β(2) irrationality is open
All four constants (π/4, ln2, π²/12, G) arise from same pattern
mathlibGaps: Abel theorem for boundary convergence of power series (needed for η(1) = ln(2))
